title: Wrong-broker guard and server identity
label: after

observations.name: failover to a healthy server of the same cluster
observations.expected: the bundle accepts any evento-lab-cluster server behind the VIP and EUROPA works again
observations.expectedBeforeFix: the single expected id rejects every healthy failover target: server_instance_mismatch loop (G13)

notes: Foreign-cluster rejection (the other half of the G13 fix) needs a 4th server with EVENTO_CLUSTER_NAME set to something else; not part of the default topology.
